summary: Layer 1B expansion found one dominant US-OTC reference supplier and three US-listed/US-OTC underfollowed or shadow candidates tied to high-speed AI substrates, PCB materials, advanced PCB fabrication, and packaging/substrate equipment. The highest-confidence direct node anchor is Nitto Boseki/Nittobo via US OTC NBCLF, because external evidence repeatedly identifies it as the dominant T-glass supplier and capacity bottleneck. The best underfollowed US-listed discovery candidates are Rogers for low-loss high-speed laminates, TTM Technologies for AI/data-center advanced PCBs consuming these materials, and Amtech Systems as a speculative small-cap equipment/consumables provider for AI semiconductor packaging and advanced wafer substrate fabrication. Non-US primary listings and private material suppliers remain an explicit coverage gap.
